name: Sichuan Style Stir-Fried Chinese Long Beans
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical stir-fry portion sizes using 1/2 lb beans as main ingredient (2 modest side servings or 1-2 light meal servings).
Preparation time estimated from quick stir-fry method (washing/cutting beans ~5 min, stir-frying ~5-10 min) based on similar recipes, as instructions omit explicit steps.
Sesame seed oil introduces sesame allergen (true).
Soy sauce introduces soy allergen (true) and likely wheat (null, as unspecified if tamari or wheat-free).
No milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts confidently absent.
Gluten-free is null due to potential wheat in soy sauce; recipe is otherwise compatible but not certified gluten-free.
All other diets true as all ingredients are plant-based with no incompatibilities.
instructions:
Chinese long beans can be found in both green and purple varieties. Both have similar flavors and textures, and either kind can be used for this recipe.
If you don't have a wok, use a sturdy, large sauté pan that has at least a two-inch lip.

ingredients.name: Chinese Long Beans
ingredients.assumptions: Standard raw Chinese long beans (yardlong beans); 1/2 lb = 227 g edible portion, typical values for raw green beans adjusted for this variety.

ingredients.name: Peanut Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Peanut oil; 1 tablespoon = 14 g, pure fat oil values.

ingredients.name: Dried Chillies
ingredients.assumptions: Dried chillies; 6 typical small dried red chillies ≈ 12 g total edible weight (including seeds), standard dried chili pepper nutrition.

ingredients.name: Sichuan Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Sichuan peppercorns; 1 tsp whole ≈ 2 g, typical values for dried Sichuan pepper.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Table salt; 1/4 tsp ≈ 1.5 g, sodium chloride contributes zero macros.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Granulated sugar; 1/2 tsp ≈ 2 g, pure sucrose values.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Sesame seed oil; 1 tablespoon = 14 g, pure fat oil values.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Soy sauce; 'splash' assumed as 1 tablespoon (15 g) for stir-fry seasoning, typical light soy sauce values.
